disclosure_event.feedback_boundary: Before Loop feedback may be considered; late feedback is external/new Request.

parameters.aperture_construction: Build the front chamber wall from full-depth stone jambs, sill and lintel surrounding a genuinely square opening. Connect their inner faces to a hollow chamber with a floor, interior walls and roof support. Keep the opening unobstructed and its wall thickness and interior depth visible. Do not place a filled panel, painted rectangle or shallow recess behind the opening. Infer other chamber faces conservatively rather than copying every dark region as a confirmed opening.
parameters.independent_evidence_requirements: The host must freshly import the exported GLB and render canonical front, back, side and elevated neutral views at 512x512, plus a material perspective and front/oblique aperture-detail views at 768x768. Detail views must reveal the square frame, wall thickness and hollow interior; darkness alone is insufficient. Record imported object names, mesh/polygon counts and bounds. Review all C01-C04 independently against the supplied reference, accounting for foreground occlusion.
parameters.instruction: Author a deterministic bpy source and export a complete stone lantern GLB at approximately 2 units overall height. Follow the supplied reference: broad low roof with flared eaves and a small stacked cap, compact framed chamber, projecting horizontal platform, and substantial rounded support base with arch-shaped negative spaces. Establish primary proportions before modest weathering and edge refinement. Exclude the person, foreground stake, vegetation and background objects. Preserve inspectable source and supporting blend artifacts.
parameters.iteration_policy: Use local correction Attempts for proportion, aperture, support, material or evidence defects under this Workflow. Preserve successful geometry during repair. If a meaningful construction-strategy change is needed, propose a versioned Workflow revision and select it through a separate explicit Production Run restart. Do not weaken criteria or claim acceptance before every mandatory outcome is MET.
parameters.materials: Use export-compatible restrained gray-stone materials with modest variation. Keep weathering subordinate to silhouette, aperture readability and smooth curved base forms.
parameters.reference_interpretation: The roof is substantially wider than the chamber; the platform projects beyond the chamber; the arched base is broad and substantial. Match these visible relationships without claiming exact physical measurements. Complete hidden surfaces conservatively. A connected four-support base is permitted as an inference; do not introduce competing decorative features.
